title: fruit notifications for blox fruit game
features: This is sample notification Fruit spawn for Blox fruit
script:
DevilShop:addToggle("Fruit Notification", _G.FruitCheck, function(Value)
    _G.FruitCheck = Value
end)
spawn(function()
    while wait(.1) do
        if _G.FruitCheck then
            for i,v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("Tool") then
                    require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Notification).new(v.Name.." Spawned"):Display();
                    wait()
                    setthreadcontext(5)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
